preregistration.prior_evidence: EXP-0079 fixed the observed empty-to-Alpha constants before this validation was designed.
preregistration.prior_transport_abort: The first committed plan was never acquired: Windows rejected the outer encoded PowerShell command line before the staged runner, provider probe, or DAO executed, and no outbox was created. This successor replaces that transport with one bounded, shell-safe direct x86 PowerShell command.
preregistration.authorization: The user explicitly authorized this and future local Windows VM usage for the current session. Acquisition remains forbidden until this plan and its exact pins are reviewed and committed.
preregistration.attempt_policy: Dispatch exactly one three-replica run. Once the first DAO control mutation begins, any failure is a scientific result and must not be retried without a new human decision.

evidence_boundary.purpose: Test whether DAO 3.6 can structurally consume the deterministic crate-private empty and first-create composer images at the preregistered bounded endpoints.
not_claimed: arbitrary schemas, relationships, indexes, or initial rows

per_replica: copy and read only the pinned 20-page empty candidate
copy and read only the pinned 23-page Alpha candidate
create one fresh DAO Jet 3 Alpha control, then read it through the same Alpha endpoints
execution.candidate_open_mode: DAO OpenDatabase with read-only true; hash and size immediately before and after all endpoint reads

empty_candidate: TableDefs is exactly MSysACEs, MSysObjects, MSysQueries, and MSysRelationships
Containers(Tables).Documents has exactly the same four names
alpha_candidate_and_control: TableDefs is exactly Alpha plus the four system definitions
Fields.Item(Id) resolves exactly one Long field
the TableDef and Field property collections enumerate within bounds and Field.Required is false
OpenRecordset(Alpha, snapshot) succeeds and is empty
Containers(Tables).Documents.Item(Alpha) resolves and the document inventory is exact

questions.empty_candidate: Do all three copies of the pinned empty image pass every empty endpoint without a byte change?
questions.alpha_candidate: Do all three copies of the pinned Alpha image pass every Alpha endpoint without a byte change?

decision_rule.observed_accepted: All three controls pass unchanged, and all three candidate replicas pass the complete endpoint list unchanged with identical observations.
decision_rule.not_observed_accepted: All three controls pass unchanged, and all three candidate replicas stop at the same endpoint with identical bounded observations and no candidate byte change.
decision_rule.no_outcome: Use when a control fails or changes, a candidate changes, replicas disagree, or the scientific job is incomplete.
decision_rule.validation_rejection: Reject without a canonical report when any pin, inventory, bound, or result-integrity check fails.
decision_rule.report_status: accepted only when both questions are either observed_accepted or not_observed_accepted; otherwise no_outcome

retention.publish: environment.json, result.json, the bounded job result, exactly the referenced MDB inventory, and the deterministic analyzer report
retention.repository: Never commit MDB bytes or provider binaries. Record the accepted report identity and bounded conclusion once as an additive provenance entry.
